episodeTitle.en: An inside look at X’s Community Notes | Keith Coleman & Jay Baxter
episodeTitle.zh: X社区笔记内幕解析 | 基思·科尔曼与杰伊·巴克斯特

guestBioOfficial.en: Keith Coleman (VP of Product) and Jay Baxter (founding ML engineer), the minds behind Community Notes, reveal how a small, scrappy team inside Twitter/X built the most trusted crowdsourced information system on the internet—one that’s changing the way we understand truth online. What you'll learn: 1. How Community Notes actually works—a deep dive into the groundbreaking algorithm that rewards “bridging agreement” instead of majority rule
guestBioOfficial.zh: 推特/X内部的Keith Coleman（产品副总裁）和Jay Baxter（创始ML工程师）——Community Notes背后的智囊团，揭秘如何在推特内部打造互联网上最受信任的众包信息系统，并彻底改变我们理解网络真相的方式。您将学习：1. 社区笔记的实际运作机制——深入解析开创性算法如何奖励“桥梁共识”而非多数规则

title.en: An inside look at X’s Community Notes | Keith Coleman & Jay Baxter
title.zh: X社区笔记内幕解析 | 基思·科尔曼与杰伊·巴克斯特

summary.en: Keith and Jay explain how Community Notes works: anyone can propose a note, and notes are rated by people who have historically disagreed, which keeps them neutral and accurate. They insist all of humanity should be eligible to participate - including elites, advertisers, and government figures. Independent studies show notes genuinely shift users' agreement with misleading claims.
summary.zh: 基思和杰伊解释了 Community Notes 的运作方式：任何人都可以提议备注，而备注由历史上观点相左的人来评分，从而保持中立与准确。他们坚持认为全人类都应可参与——包括精英、广告主和政府人士。独立研究表明，这些备注确实能改变用户对误导内容的认同。
